a11y.motion: Icons stay at their base size and never magnify; only the hover color change remains.
a11y.keyboard: Each DockIcon is a native button, or a link when href is set, reachable with Tab and activated with Enter (and Space for buttons); focus shows a ring and magnifies the icon and its neighbours.
a11y.screenReader: Each icon is announced as a button or link named by its label prop.
